title: 第1章 源卡大陆
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
传说，宇宙初开时，世间唯有一片混沌翻腾的源卡之海。

    万物运行的规则、天地间奔涌的能量、生灵的灵魂，皆以镌刻着神秘纹路的卡牌形态存在。

    这片由无数卡牌交织构筑的世界，也因此被冠以源卡大陆之名。

    在源卡大陆的中央腹地，四座强盛国度如雄狮般分据四方，彼此制衡。

    其中实力最顶尖的，当属坐拥中央平原核心地带的神圣帝国。

    神圣帝国疆域北接终年飘雪的凛冬王国，西临炉火不熄的熔岩王国，南连兽灵共生的百兽王国，唯有东方，是一片望不到尽头的蔚蓝深海。

    让我们将视角从高空缓缓俯瞰，穿过熔岩王国连绵的铁矿山脉，最终定格在边境一座被石铁城墙环绕的小城。

    石铁城

    铁毡公国，石铁城。

    今日的石铁城，比市集日还要热闹三分。

    街道上的行人脚步匆匆，商贩们也早早收了摊，所有人的目光都不约而同地朝着城中最高的建筑望去。

    那是一座由红色石块铸造的熔炉教堂，尖顶直插云霄，墙体上刻满了象征源卡之神的符文，此刻正散发着淡淡的暖光。

    “伟大的源卡之神啊！我恳求您，一定要保佑我觉醒个强大的本命卡。”

    熔炉教堂外大排长龙，随处可见跪地祈祷的身影。

    有人五体投地，有人倒挂金钩，还有人撒泼打滚。总之，每个人都是主角，但又都是配角。

    而在这支充满敬畏与焦虑的队伍后方，一个十五岁左右的少年，却显得格格不入。

    他穿着一身洗得柔软的灰布短衫，身姿挺拔如松，双手随意地抱在胸前，漆黑的眼眸里没有丝毫祈求的卑微，反倒带着几分漫不经心的审视，仿佛眼前这场热闹的大典，与他无关一般。

    “儿子，儿子！你快跪下求求源卡之神啊！别总站着，显得不恭敬！”

    一旁跪地祈祷的林峰戳了戳林奇的小腿，试图劝他也来临时抱个源脚。

    林奇低头瞥了眼老爹一眼，觉得他这祈祷有还不如没有的好。

    别说五体投地的恭敬了，连句正经的祈祷词都说不出来，嘴里翻来覆去就念叨着“要绿卡”“要蓝卡”。

    你这哪里是在祈求祷告？你从这里纯要啊！

    “源卡之神要是能理你，我都不叫林奇！”

    见林峰依旧撅着大腚偷窥前面同样跪地的一个妇人，林奇当即轻踢了他一脚。

    林峰吓得浑身一激灵，连忙把头埋得更低，双手紧紧攥成拳头贴在胸口，语速飞快地胡乱念叨。

    “源卡之神保佑！保佑我儿觉醒好卡！保佑我家生意兴隆！保佑…… 呃，保佑前面大姐的裙子别被风吹起来！”

    这一阵絮絮叨叨让林奇听得头大。

    “老爹，赶紧起来吧，你这套花里胡哨的没用。”

    林峰偷偷抬起头，飞快地扫了眼四周，见没人注意自己这才松了口气。

    随即，他又板起脸开始教育儿子。

    “怎么没用？隔壁你王叔他儿子，和你一样大的年纪，不就是因为当年虔诚拜了源卡之神，十二岁就觉醒了本命卡，人家现在都快成二星卡徒了！”
content_en:
Legend has it that when the universe first opened, there was only a chaotic and churning sea of ​​source cards.

The rules for the operation of all things, the energy rushing between heaven and earth, and the souls of living creatures all exist in the form of cards engraved with mysterious patterns.

This world is composed of countless cards intertwined and is therefore called the Source Card Continent.

In the central hinterland of the Yuanka Continent, four powerful countries dominate the four directions like lions, checking and balancing each other.

Among them, the most powerful one is undoubtedly the Holy Empire, which sits in the core area of ​​the Central Plains.

The territory of the Holy Empire is bounded to the north by the Kingdom of Winter, where snow falls all year round, to the west by the Kingdom of Lava, where the fire never goes out, and to the south by the Kingdom of Beasts, where beasts and spirits coexist. Only in the east is a deep blue sea with no end in sight.

Let us slowly look down from a high altitude, pass through the continuous iron ore mountains of the Lava Kingdom, and finally settle on a small city on the border surrounded by stone and iron walls.

Shi Tiecheng

The Principality of Tiezhen, Shitiecheng.

Today's Shitie City is even more lively than on market day.

Pedestrians on the street were in a hurry, and vendors had closed their stalls early. Everyone's eyes were looking towards the tallest building in the city.

It was a furnace church made of red stone, with a spire reaching into the sky. The walls were engraved with runes symbolizing the God of Source Card, and it was emitting a faint warm light at the moment.

"Great God of Source Cards! I beg you to help me awaken a powerful natal card."

There was a long queue outside the Melting Pot Church, and figures kneeling in prayer could be seen everywhere.

Some people fell to the ground, some hung upside down on golden hooks, and some were rolling around.In short, everyone is the protagonist, but also a supporting role.

But behind this team full of awe and anxiety, a boy of about fifteen years old seemed out of place.

He was wearing a soft washed gray cloth blouse, his figure was as tall as a pine tree, his hands were clasped casually in front of his chest, and there was no humbleness of prayer in his dark eyes, but rather a somewhat casual look, as if the lively ceremony in front of him had nothing to do with him.

"Son, son! Kneel down and beg the God of Source Card! Don't stand all the time, it seems disrespectful!"

Lin Feng, who was kneeling to pray at the side, poked Lin Qi's calf, trying to persuade him to come and hold him for a while.

Lynch lowered his head and glanced at his father, feeling that his prayer was worse than nothing.

Not to mention the prostrate respect, I couldn't even say a serious prayer. I kept mumbling "I want a green card" and "I want a blue card" over and over again.

Where are you praying?You just want it from here!

"If the God of Source Card could care about you, I wouldn't even call you Lynch!"

Seeing Lin Feng still sticking his big butt out to peek at a woman who was also kneeling in front of him, Lin Qi immediately kicked him lightly.

Lin Feng was so frightened that his whole body trembled, and he quickly buried his head lower, clenched his hands tightly into fists and put them against his chest, and murmured rapidly.

"Bless the god of source cards! Bless my son for awakening good cards! Bless my family's business to be prosperous! Bless... uh, bless the skirt of the eldest sister in front not to be blown up by the wind!"

This chatter made Lynch feel dizzy.

"Dad, get up quickly, all your fancy tricks are useless."

Lin Feng secretly raised his head and quickly glanced around. He was relieved when he saw that no one was paying attention to him.

Immediately, he put on a straight face and began to educate his son.

"Why is it useless? Your uncle Wang's son next door is the same age as you. Isn't it because he worshiped the God of Source Card religiously and awakened his natal card at the age of twelve? He is now almost a two-star card disciple!"
